faqs.question: How much does a website cost in Pakistan?
faqs.answer: WordbitX websites start at Rs. 20,000 on your own domain and hosting, or Rs. 25,000 with a domain and one year of hosting. Market estimates are PKR 30,000–60,000 for a basic freelancer build, PKR 60,000–150,000 for a small agency, and PKR 150,000–350,000+ for an established agency.

faqs.question: What is included in the starter website price?
faqs.answer: The published scope covers 5–10 pages, CMS editing, basic SEO and three months of support. The Rs. 20,000 option uses your hosting; Rs. 25,000 adds a domain and one year of hosting.

faqs.question: How much does website renewal cost?
faqs.answer: WordbitX renewal starts from Rs. 10,000 per year. Confirm the exact services, domain terms and invoice rather than assuming unlimited maintenance is included.

faqs.question: Is WordbitX the cheapest website developer in Pakistan?
faqs.answer: No such claim is made. Competitors advertise from PKR 5,000. Under PKR 10,000–15,000 usually means a copied template with weak security and no support; compare actual scope and ownership.

faqs.question: How much does a mobile app cost in Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Market planning ranges are PKR 180,000–600,000 for a simple app, PKR 500,000–2,500,000 for a medium app, and PKR 2,000,000–8,000,000+ for a complex app. These are market estimates, not WordbitX fixed packages.

faqs.question: Android or iOS — which app should I build first?
faqs.answer: Choose using your actual customers’ devices and required features. Cross-platform development may fit both; specialised hardware or platform requirements may justify native development.

faqs.question: Does Flutter reduce app development cost?
faqs.answer: Supplied market guidance suggests roughly 30–40% savings versus two native apps. This is not guaranteed: native integrations, design differences and testing still affect the quote.

faqs.question: How long does it take to build a mobile app?
faqs.answer: A simple app commonly takes 1–3 months and a medium app 3–6 months. Backend readiness, integrations, content and store review affect the final schedule.

faqs.question: How much does a Shopify store cost in Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Supplied market estimates put Shopify setup at PKR 45,000–500,000+ and running costs around PKR 8,000–25,000 per month. Basic is listed in the supplied research at $29/month, approximately PKR 8,000; check billing terms and current official pricing before subscribing.

faqs.question: Is there a Shopify discount code?
faqs.answer: The supplied official offer is three days free, then $1/month for three months on Basic/Grow/Advanced. It is automatic, not a coupon code. Verify current eligibility at official checkout.

faqs.question: How long does it take to build a Shopify store?
faqs.answer: Use the e-commerce planning range of 4–10 weeks and request a scope-specific estimate. Product preparation, payments, shipping and custom theme work can change the launch date.

faqs.question: Does the Shopify setup fee include monthly running costs?
faqs.answer: Not automatically. Separate setup work from the platform subscription, optional apps, domain, payments and ongoing support. The supplied running-cost estimate is PKR 8,000–25,000 per month.

faqs.question: How much does an e-commerce website cost in Pakistan?
faqs.answer: There is no single store price. Shopify setup market estimates are PKR 45,000–500,000+; WordbitX custom stores and software start around Rs. 2,50,000, with the actual scope quoted after discussion.

faqs.question: Shopify or WooCommerce — which is better for Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Shopify reduces infrastructure work but has recurring subscriptions and apps. WooCommerce offers hosting control with update responsibility. Check payment eligibility, delivery needs and total annual costs.

faqs.question: When does an online store need custom development?
faqs.answer: Consider custom work when a specific approval, stock or integration rule cannot be handled cleanly by standard platforms. Write the rule and acceptance checks before requesting a custom quote.

faqs.question: How long does an e-commerce website take?
faqs.answer: A typical planning range is 4–10 weeks. Product content, payment approval, delivery rules, migration and testing affect your actual schedule.

faqs.question: How much does SEO cost in Pakistan?
faqs.answer: WordbitX quotes SEO after reviewing the website, competition and goals. No verified fixed monthly SEO price is supplied, so this guide does not invent one. Request a written scope covering technical work, content and reporting.

faqs.question: How long does SEO take to show results?
faqs.answer: Noticeable improvements usually need 3–4 months and can take longer for competitive or new sites. No first-page position or number of leads is guaranteed.

faqs.question: What should a monthly SEO quote include?
faqs.answer: Ask for the pages being improved, technical implementation, content responsibilities and useful reporting. Confirm who publishes changes, what needs your approval and which costs sit outside the scope.

faqs.question: Can an SEO agency guarantee number one on Google?
faqs.answer: No honest supplier can guarantee every search position. Choose using transparent work, account ownership, relevant reporting and realistic timelines rather than a promised ranking.

faqs.question: How to hire a web developer in Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Write a short brief, review live work, compare written quotes, confirm code and account ownership, and agree support terms before paying. Market hourly estimates are PKR 500–5,000 for freelancers and PKR 1,000–8,000+ for agencies.

faqs.question: Should I hire a freelancer or an agency?
faqs.answer: A freelancer may suit a limited, clear brief. An agency may provide more continuity and specialist roles. Check who actually builds, tests and supports the project.

faqs.question: What should I check before hiring a developer?
faqs.answer: Review live work on a phone, ask what the candidate built and obtain written scope, milestones, ownership, licence and support terms. Keep business accounts under your control.

faqs.question: How much does a dedicated developer cost?
faqs.answer: WordbitX dedicated developer pricing is Get a quote. Define skills, working hours and management responsibilities; do not apply a website package price to a staffing engagement.

faqs.question: Which is better, WordPress or a custom website?
faqs.answer: WordPress often fits editable business content; a custom build fits unusual workflows and integrations. Choose using ownership, maintenance, security and what staff must do each day, not the label alone.

faqs.question: Is WordPress suitable for a small business website?
faqs.answer: Often yes when the main need is editable service pages, articles and enquiry forms. Ask for editor training, licensed components, updates and a tested backup process.

faqs.question: Does a custom website automatically rank better?
faqs.answer: No. Ranking depends on useful content, crawlability, performance and many other factors. Neither WordPress nor a custom framework guarantees rankings or leads.

faqs.question: Will I own a WordPress or custom website?
faqs.answer: Ownership depends on the agreement and access. Confirm the repository, domain, hosting, admin accounts and third-party licences, including what can transfer to another developer.

faqs.question: How much does custom software / POS software cost in Pakistan?
faqs.answer: WordbitX custom software starts from Rs. 2,50,000 and is quoted after scope review. Hardware, migration, integrations and support must be specified separately; the starting price is not a promise that every POS, CRM or ERP fits it.

faqs.question: How long does it take to build POS software?
faqs.answer: No universal confirmed POS timeline is available. Devices, branches, migration, offline sync and tax integration need a scoped delivery plan with staged testing.

faqs.question: Does a POS quote include hardware and FBR integration?
faqs.answer: Only if the written scope says so. Confirm scanners, printers, tax requirements, external approvals and integration responsibilities separately; do not assume a billing screen proves compliance.

faqs.question: Should I buy ready-made software or build custom?
faqs.answer: Use existing software when it fits the daily workflow and data needs. Consider custom work for important rules that otherwise need fragile workarounds, with maintenance and migration included in the decision.

faqs.question: How long does it take to build a website?
faqs.answer: Planning ranges are 1–3 weeks for a starter website, 3–6 weeks for a custom business site, and 4–10 weeks for e-commerce. Simple apps commonly take 1–3 months and medium apps 3–6 months; content, review and integrations affect the schedule.

faqs.question: How long does it take to build a mobile app?
faqs.answer: A simple app commonly needs 1–3 months; a medium app 3–6 months. Store review, account checks and external integrations are separate dependencies.

faqs.question: Can a website launch faster if I prepare content?
faqs.answer: Yes, approved page content, real images and a single decision-maker remove common blockers. Confirm whether the schedule assumes content is ready at kickoff.

faqs.question: Does a launch date include testing and handover?
faqs.answer: It should explicitly include mobile checks, forms, permissions, recovery paths and account access. Ask for checkpoints and record any external approvals outside the developer’s control.

faqs.question: How to rank my business on Google in Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Keep an eligible Google Business Profile accurate, publish useful service pages, make contact details consistent and improve mobile performance. SEO usually needs months, not days; no supplier can guarantee a map position.

faqs.question: Does my business need a Google Business Profile?
faqs.answer: If eligible under Google’s rules, an accurate profile can help customers find business details. Use your real identity and service area; do not create fake city offices.

faqs.question: Can local SEO guarantee a map ranking?
faqs.answer: No. Positions vary with location, intent and competition. Measure relevant traffic and genuine enquiries alongside accuracy and technical improvements.

faqs.question: Should I create a different page for every city?
faqs.answer: Only when the page provides genuine service information for that location. Repeated city names and fake addresses do not replace useful content or a real service area.

faqs.question: How much does a domain cost in Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Market estimates are PKR 3,000–6,000 per year for .com and PKR 2,000–4,000 per year for .pk or .com.pk. Billing periods, tax and renewal terms vary; check the registrar’s actual invoice.

faqs.question: Is a domain the same as hosting?
faqs.answer: No. The domain is the address and hosting runs the website. Email may be separate. Confirm ownership, billing periods, recovery access and renewal dates for each service.

faqs.question: Is hosting included with WordbitX?
faqs.answer: One year of hosting and a domain are included in the Rs. 25,000 website package. The Rs. 20,000 package uses your existing setup. Renewal starts from Rs. 10,000/year.

faqs.question: Can I pay with JazzCash or Easypaisa?
faqs.answer: Ask WordbitX to confirm accepted methods on your invoice. These options are not confirmed here, and another provider’s payment methods should not be assumed to apply.

faqs.question: How much does web hosting cost in Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Market annual ranges are PKR 1,500–15,000 for shared hosting, PKR 5,000–15,000 for WordPress hosting, PKR 20,000–80,000+ for VPS, and PKR 30,000–100,000+ for managed hosting. These are not WordbitX hosting plans.

faqs.question: Shared vs VPS hosting — which should I choose?
faqs.answer: Shared can suit a modest content site. VPS offers more control but needs server administration unless management is included. Check workload, backups and support, not only memory or disk space.

faqs.question: What is the cheapest hosting in Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Shared hosting market estimates start around PKR 1,500/year, but no single cheapest host is verified here. Check limits, taxes, backups and especially renewal terms.

faqs.question: Will hosting renew at a higher price?
faqs.answer: Many hosts renew at double or triple their signup price. WordbitX package renewal starts from Rs. 10,000/year; confirm the current amount and scope before payment.

faqs.question: How can I get a discount on a website?
faqs.answer: Reduce unnecessary scope, prepare content and compare full written quotes. WordbitX has no published coupon code here; its standard websites start at Rs. 20,000 or Rs. 25,000 with domain and one year of hosting.

faqs.question: Does WordbitX have a coupon code?
faqs.answer: No owner-confirmed code is published here. Standard websites start at Rs. 20,000, or Rs. 25,000 with domain and one year of hosting. A code must be created and honoured by the owner.

faqs.question: Are coupon code websites real?
faqs.answer: Some list genuine offers; others list expired codes or repackage automatic public offers. Verify at official checkout and never share passwords or pay a stranger to unlock a supposed code.

faqs.question: What is the Shopify no-code offer?
faqs.answer: The supplied offer is three days free and $1/month for three months on Basic/Grow/Advanced, automatically applied. Check current eligibility and normal billing before subscribing.

faqs.question: How much does an AI chatbot cost?
faqs.answer: WordbitX’s live AI service page gives an indicative Pakistan project range of Rs. 2,50,000–10,00,000. That is a broad AI service range, not a fixed chatbot package; a chatbot needs a quote covering its data, integrations, safety checks and usage costs.

faqs.question: What makes an AI chatbot more expensive?
faqs.answer: Data cleanup, retrieval search, multiple integrations, permissions, human review and evaluation increase work. Traffic and model usage affect running costs; ask for explicit limits and monitoring.

faqs.question: Can a chatbot answer every customer question?
faqs.answer: No. It should use approved company information and hand off missing or sensitive questions to staff. Do not let it invent prices, medical advice or unauthorised discounts.

faqs.question: Is the quoted AI project cost a monthly subscription?
faqs.answer: The live range describes indicative AI project work, not a universal subscription or fixed chatbot package. Ask separately about API usage, storage, maintenance and later changes.

faqs.question: What is AI automation?
faqs.answer: AI automation uses a model to interpret information inside a workflow, such as classifying a message or extracting invoice fields, then routes the next step. Keep human approval for important decisions and use ordinary rules when they are enough.

faqs.question: How can AI help a salon, clinic or real estate team?
faqs.answer: It could draft approved service replies, route administrative enquiries or summarise verified listings. These are possible uses, not claimed client results. Staff must check sensitive or consequential outputs.

faqs.question: Which AI tool is best for small business in Pakistan?
faqs.answer: There is no universal winner. Compare privacy, language quality, integration, export options and ongoing cost. The existing small-business tools guide covers selection without inventing a new ranking.

faqs.question: Does AI automation replace staff?
faqs.answer: Not by default. Start with a repeated task, use human review where errors matter and compare against a simpler rules-based solution. Measure useful outputs before expanding access or actions.

faqs.question: Can AI build my website?
faqs.answer: AI builders are fast and cheap for a basic page. A developer is needed for a business website that must rank, convert and be owned outright, with reliable integrations, testing and a clear handover. AI can assist that work but does not remove responsibility.

faqs.question: Can an AI builder replace a developer for a business website?
faqs.answer: Not reliably when ranking, conversion, integrations and outright code ownership are requirements. AI can help draft or prototype, while a developer remains accountable for production testing and handover.

faqs.question: Will I own a website made by an AI builder?
faqs.answer: Read the export, account and cancellation terms. Owning the domain is not the same as receiving an editable codebase. Check how content, forms and data move if you leave.

faqs.question: Does WordbitX sell an AI website-builder product?
faqs.answer: No such product is claimed here. WordbitX’s live AI services cover assistants, document intelligence, predictive analytics and workflow automation. Discuss the website itself through web development.
